comment: The languages the converter writes (ADR 0016): each one's Remastered locale directory and its name in its own language. exceptions list a language's rows allowed to differ from the base in their % specifiers: locale, table (a strings.kpd section), row id, why. rows lists a language's shorter text for a table row whose own does not fit where it shows (stage L3): locale, table, row id (1-based), text (an inner NUL written \u0007, as Remastered's XML has it), why. layout lists a dialog record's rectangle a language's text needs (localization's stage L3, tests/c/test_locale.c's the_languages_texts_fit): locale, dialog, record (0 is the dialog), rect [left, top, right, bottom] inclusive, why.

exceptions.why: "% Complete" and its translation have a bare percent sign, no conversion: no format string reads the row

rows.why: "Неиспользуемое строение зергов 5" is 184 pixels in font10, past the status panel's name even widened (174); the other unused buildings' names fit

layout.why: the status panel's unit name: Russian names reach 173 pixels in font10 ("Неиспользуемое строение зергов"), the control had 152; it takes the panel's empty sides, past the wireframe (30..93) to the dialog's edge (269)
the supply lines' labels ("Затрачено припасов: 200", 107 pixels) and the next three: the control had 111 pixels; their right side is empty while supply shows
the third supply line, as the others
the morph label "Создание пристройки" is 110 pixels, the control had 108
"Общий счет" in font16x is 131 pixels, 1 past the right-aligned label's 491..621; its left moves 4 pixels into the empty space before it
